name.fr-FR: Le Cœur admirable de la très sacrée Mère de Dieu
name.en-US: The Admirable Heart of the Most Sacred Mother of God
name.pt-BR: O Coração admirável da santíssima Mãe de Deus

description.fr-FR: La grande œuvre de Jean Eudes (douze livres, 1681) : la dévotion au Cœur de Marie et, en elle, au Cœur de Jésus. Les livres I à IV, V à IX et X à XII sont dans les tomes VI, VII et VIII des Œuvres complètes.
description.en-US: John Eudes’s great work (twelve books, 1681): devotion to the Heart of Mary and, in her, to the Heart of Jesus. Books I–IV, V–IX and X–XII are in volumes VI, VII and VIII of the Complete Works.
description.pt-BR: A grande obra de João Eudes (doze livros, 1681): a devoção ao Coração de Maria e, nele, ao Coração de Jesus. Os livros I a IV, V a IX e X a XII estão nos tomos VI, VII e VIII das Obras completas.

fr-FR.editor: Charles Lebrun, Ange Le Doré, Joseph Dauphin (Congrégation de Jésus et Marie)

sources.edition: Œuvres complètes du Vénérable Jean Eudes, tome 6, Vannes (Lafolye) et Paris (Beauchesne), 1905–1911, éd. Ch. Lebrun, A. Le Doré, J. Dauphin; transcription Bibliothèque Saint Libère (liberius.net), 2008.
sources.description: Born-digital transcription of the 1905–11 edition, converted by script: page markers and running heads removed, hyphenation and leaked letter-spacing repaired, paragraphs rejoined; the editors’ footnotes are gathered at the end of the file where they fall; footnote call numbers stay in the running text. The editors’ introductions are kept.
sources.tierEvidence: Eudes died in 1680; the 1905–11 edition is public domain.
